entities.name: 自动合并 (auto-merge)

evidence.quote: So you can see that this auto-merge uh label is down here.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And the fact that that uh is set to auto-merge, if that wasn't there, presumably that then would require a human to go in, maybe review the PR and actually push it themselves.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: So auto merge is an optional label that just gets the bot to literally select auto merge on the GitHub PR uh so that it will go in once CI is green.

evidence.quote: The second one, because it's uh a PR that goes directly to the Dart Factory, it's a PR for the Dart Factory, uh, that will auto-merge, so as soon as it's done, it will it will squash that down and merge that into the code base.

evidence.quote: Because they just our policy is that we only allow auto merge on um stuff that is in our research code base, stuff that is in our dark factory code base, and stuff that um our GTM team is building uh using the Dark Factory to help uh build out their own internal flows too.

evidence.quote: Like you've got a couple ideas, just go kick them off and don't send them an auto merge and go look at the code.

entities.how_described: 本集说出问题时不回滚 PR，而是问'验证端漏掉了什么'，然后补验证器或补测试，让同类问题不再发生

evidence.quote: But the intention, what we're trying to do there is overshare the context so that we're aware, but then also fix forward.

evidence.quote: It is, okay, cool, what we missed on the verification side that allowed this to land, either in a verifier if it's a human concept, or on tests if it's something bad, so that we can continually fix forward and build those guardrails, earn that trust on the autonomy side that you mentioned.
